title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Position Summary**

CDK Global is seeking an **Associate Product Manager** to support OEM and Enterprise initiatives focused on improving the automotive ownership and service experience for dealers and consumers. This role is ideal for an early-career product professional who is passionate about learning the automotive ecosystem, building strong stakeholder relationships, and developing exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

The Associate Product Manager will work closely with OEM partners, Product Managers, Program Managers, Engineering teams, UX teams, and business stakeholders to understand OEM objectives, dealer operational challenges, and customer experience opportunities. A key responsibility will be developing expertise in OEM programs and understanding how they influence dealer performance, customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term loyalty.

This role will support initiatives that help OEMs achieve key success metrics, including customer satisfaction and loyalty measures often reflected in industry benchmarking programs such as J.D. Power studies and OEM-specific satisfaction programs. The Associate Product Manager will help translate OEM requirements into product enhancements that improve both digital and in-store customer experiences across the service journey.

As the automotive service industry evolves, this role will contribute to product strategies that extend beyond online appointment scheduling to support a broader Fixed Operations ecosystem, including service lane experiences, scheduled maintenance programs, OEM parts and tire sales, marketing and customer retention capabilities, service recommendations, digital engagement solutions, and emerging payment options such as Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL).

**Key Responsibilities**

**OEM Program Knowledge & Product Support**

* Develop a deep understanding of OEM service programs, customer experience initiatives, and dealer operational processes.

* Learn how OEM objectives translate into dealer workflows, customer outcomes, and product requirements.

* Support Product Managers in evaluating OEM requests, enhancements, and strategic opportunities.

* Research competitive offerings, market trends, and industry best practices.

* Build domain expertise across Fixed Operations, Service, Customer Retention, and Digital Retailing solutions.

**Customer & Dealer Experience Focus**

* Develop an understanding of the dealer service journey from online scheduling through in-store service experiences.

* Support initiatives focused on:

* Online service appointment scheduling

* In-store service advisor experiences

* Scheduled maintenance programs

* OEM parts and tire sales

* Recall and service campaigns

* Customer communications and marketing

* Vehicle health and maintenance recommendations

* BNPL and flexible payment options

* Service retention and loyalty programs

* Assist in gathering feedback from dealers, OEM stakeholders, and internal teams to identify enhancement opportunities.

**Product Execution & Coordination**

* Support the definition and documentation of product requirements, user stories, and business objectives.

* Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, and release planning activities.

* Coordinate with Engineering, UX, and Quality Assurance teams throughout the product development lifecycle.

* Track feature progress and help ensure alignment with business and customer objectives.

* Assist with launch activities, adoption planning, and post-release analysis.

**Communication & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Deliver clear, professional, and effective written and verbal communications.

* Create presentations, requirements documents, executive summaries, meeting notes, and status updates.

* Facilitate discussions between Product, Engineering, OEM stakeholders, and business teams.

* Translate complex business or technical concepts into clear, actionable information for various audiences.

* Maintain product documentation and communicate decisions, priorities, and next steps.

**Data & Performance Analysis**

* Monitor and analyze product performance metrics and customer feedback.

* Develop an understanding of key OEM success measures, including:

* Customer satisfaction scores

* Service retention metrics

* Dealer engagement and adoption metrics

* Loyalty and repeat visit indicators

* J.D. Power-related performance drivers

* OEM program participation and effectiveness

**Learning & Product Development**

* Demonstrate a strong desire to learn the automotive industry, OEM strategies, dealer operations, and customer experience best practices.

* Continuously build knowledge of Fixed Operations processes and emerging service technologies.

* Participate in OEM discussions, and internal strategy sessions.

* Develop product management fundamentals including requirements gathering, prioritization, roadmap planning, and product discovery.

**Preferred:**

* **Experience in Agile software/DevOps methodologies & working with globally distributed teams.**

**Education/Experience**

title: Product Manager, AI
description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.

Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.

### **How you'll make an impact:**

As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.

You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.

### **What you'll do:**

* Turn business goals into clear software requirements.
* Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each.
* Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy.
* Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed.
* Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch.
* Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results.
* Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models.
* Rank feature requests from the development teams.
* Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications.
* Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs.
* Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear.
* Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity.

### **What you'll bring:**

* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus.
* Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models.
* Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code.
* Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them.
* Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle.
* Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management.
* Structured approach and experience with agile methods.
* History of working with development teams to get results.
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves.
* Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do.
* Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

### **Why Work for Us?**

* We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
* Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
* Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
* A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
* Recruitment referral bonus
* Work for a Great Place to Work®

**Why CIN7?**

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.

At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.

***We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. We understand the importance of creating a safe and comfortable work environment and encourage individualism and authenticity in every member of our team.***

Commenda is building the agent for global legal and tax work. Teams use it to register entities, manage obligations, and stay compliant globally. Today that work requires additional headcount, local vendors, and disconnected systems.

We’re hiring a Product Manager to turn complex legal, tax, and operational work into reliable, agentic products. You’ll define how agents use company context, interpret requirements, take action, and involve people when judgment or approval is needed. You’ll work directly with customers, engineers, domain experts, and operations to build products that deliver compliance outcomes.

You’ll report to the Head of Product and start as a generalist. Over time, you may specialize in Transfer Pricing, Indirect Tax, or Entity Management. You’ll own your product roadmap, aligning it with business priorities and the company-wide roadmap.

**What you’ll work on**
-----------------------

**Build agents that get compliance work done.** Define how agents move from understanding a customer’s situation to planning and executing work. You’ll specify the context and tools they need, the actions they can take, and when they should ask for clarification, request approval, or escalate to an expert.

**Make agent behavior measurable and reliable.** Work with domain experts to define what correct behavior looks like, build evaluation datasets, and assess performance across real scenarios and edge cases. You’ll use traces, customer feedback, and expert corrections to identify failures and create feedback loops that continuously improve the product.

**Turn regulatory complexity into product behavior.** Help translate written requirements across jurisdictions into structured rules that capture applicability, conditions, exceptions, deadlines, and dependencies. You’ll define requirements and validate behavior with experts so our agents can determine what a customer needs to do and drive the next steps.

**Build and improve workflows yourself.** Work alongside operations and subject matter experts to understand how tasks are performed, then build workflows using Commenda’s workflow builder. You’ll identify where agents can take over work, where human review adds value, and how to make the overall process faster and more reliable.

**Design how customers, service providers, and agents work together.** Our products support customers buying services from Commenda, working with third-party providers, and handling work in-house. You’ll define responsibilities, permissions, handoffs, approvals, and visibility so each participant knows what needs to happen and can trust the work being done.

**Talk to customers, prototype, and prioritize.** Lead product interviews and feedback sessions, use Claude Code or Codex to prototype user journeys, and test ideas before committing engineering effort. You’ll combine customer insight, product analytics, and evaluation results to make roadmap decisions and measure whether what we ship improves outcomes.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* **At least two years of product management experience**, with examples of products or workflows you’ve taken from an ambiguous problem through launch and iteration.
* **Hands-on experience with AI evaluations.** You’ve defined what good output or behavior looks like, evaluated results against that standard, and used failures to guide improvements. You understand that a compelling demo is only the beginning of building a reliable AI product.
* **Advanced proficiency with Claude Code or Codex.** These tools are part of how you work. You can independently build prototypes, explore product ideas, and test workflows. You don’t need to know how to code, but you need to communicate effectively with engineers and define precise requirements.
* **Strong judgment about agentic user experiences.** You can reason through what an agent should do autonomously, where people need control, and how users should understand progress, review work, and recover when something goes wrong.
* **Exceptional spoken and written English and a confident customer presence.** You can lead interviews, ask precise questions, explain complex ideas clearly, and earn customers’ trust.
* **Strong ownership and organizational skills.** You can coordinate work across engineering, internal and external domain experts, operations, and customer success, keep decisions and dependencies clear, and drive unresolved issues to completion.
* **A willingness to get into the details.** You’re comfortable learning how work actually happens, investigating edge cases, configuring workflows yourself, and validating results with experts.
* **Familiarity with Figma and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel.** You use prototypes and data to understand behavior, test assumptions, and make product decisions.
* **Curiosity and rigor in complex domains.** You’re interested in developing a working knowledge of legal, tax, and regulatory requirements, checking assumptions, and preserving the details that determine the right outcome.

Experience shipping a customer-facing AI or agentic product is a plus, as is experience with Braintrust or another AI evaluation and observability platform. A background in tax, accounting, entity management, or compliance is helpful but not required.

**About the team**
------------------

We’re an ambitious, intense team spread across Bangalore, San Francisco, and Seattle. We work like a sports team: we practice, challenge each other, and take shared responsibility for winning. People here move quickly, form their own opinions, and take on problems without waiting to be assigned them.

AI is part of how we build every day. You’ll work alongside engineers and domain experts who use agents to tackle complex work, experiment with new tools, and push what the product can do. We value curiosity, imagination, and the willingness to turn an unconventional idea into something customers can use.

You’ll have real ownership early, direct access to the people making decisions, and room to grow as you prove what you can take on.

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive compensation and meaningful equity.
* Health insurance.
* A monthly self-improvement stipend for learning, fitness, or other investments in your development.
* Opportunities for international travel and collaboration with colleagues across our global offices.
* A collaborative office environment and team events.

**Who are we?**

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.  
  
Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

*Summary:*

The Staff Technical Product Manager supports the structured execution, adoption, and expansion of Data, Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence initiatives. The role works across product, business, engineering, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders to translate agreed product direction into organized backlogs, coordinated delivery routines, documented decisions, transparent progress, user feedback, effective communications, and transition readiness.

The position helps teams scale capabilities already built by improving reuse, documentation, communication, adoption, and expansion readiness. It also supports new initiatives by coordinating discovery activities, workshops, stakeholder inputs, feedback, dependencies, and follow-through.

To be successful in this role, you should have a strong background in Data & AI strategy definition and implementation, coupled with excellent leadership and communication skills. Experience in people management and a deep understanding of the business and technology landscape are also highly desirable.

If you are a strategic thinker, a passionate advocate for Data & AI innovation, and a collaborative leader, this Director of AI Strategy role presents an exciting opportunity to drive the organization's digital transformation and shape the future of its AI capabilities.

*Duties and Responsibilities:*

1. Operate a consistent product and delivery cadence across assigned initiatives, including backlog reviews, Sprint planning, daily or regular Scrum meetings, demonstrations, retrospectives, project reviews, and dependency discussions.

2. Maintain product and initiative backlogs in coordination with portfolio leadership, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, and technical leads, ensuring that items are clear, traceable, prioritized through the agreed process, and ready for execution.

3. Coordinating with Engineering Managers and technical leads to track delivery progress against agreed backlog items, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks, dependencies, and documented decisions.

4. Ensure progress visibility for infrastructure, platform, data, security, and other enabling initiatives by aggregating updates from responsible owners and highlighting significant dependencies or risks

5. Organize and facilitate discovery, product, business, and engineering workshops after the product vision and strategic direction have been established; prepare objectives and pre-work, coordinate participants, capture decisions, and track actions.

6. Plan user demonstrations, feedback sessions, testing discussions, and adoption reviews; document feedback, structure themes, route inputs to the appropriate owners, and track agreed responses.

7. Help scale capabilities already delivered by coordinating reusable documentation, playbooks, templates, user guidance, communication materials, knowledge transfer, adoption actions, and expansion readiness.

8. Prepare presentations, portfolio updates, meeting packs, agendas, pre-reads, decision logs, status summaries, and stakeholder communications based on agreed product and portfolio direction.

9. Keep product and initiative documentation accurate and up to date, covering requirements, assumptions, acceptance criteria, decisions, open questions, ownership, dependencies, lessons learned, handover details, and evidence of benefits.

10. Coordinate transition and operational readiness, ensuring that documentation, support ownership, user readiness, training inputs, communication, and post-implementation follow-up are planned and tracked.

*Minimum Qualifications:* (To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.)

* University degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* This position requires a minimum of 7 -10 years’ experience, with hands on experience in the Data & AI Product Management and project management area

*Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:*

* A good understanding of various Data platforms, Cloud or on-prem (Datalake, DWH, Datamarts, Document management, Data interoperability (ETL, API mgt)
* Abilities to define a data & AI platform as a service for enabling other IT teams to benefit from it.

* 7-10 years of overall professional experience in product management, technology program management, digital delivery, data and analytics, business transformation, product operations, or a related field.
* At least 2-3 years of experience in a comparable Product Manager, Product Operations, Agile Program, or technology delivery coordination role.
* Experience running Agile or Scrum ceremonies and maintaining backlogs across one or more business and technology initiatives.
* Experience coordinating Engineering Managers, technical leads, developers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and users in a matrixed environment.
* Experience tracking progress, risks, dependencies, milestones, decisions, and actions across concurrent initiatives.
* Experience facilitating workshops, demonstrations, feedback sessions, planning discussions, and cross-functional working meetings.
* Experience preparing clear presentations, status reports, pre-reads, decision materials, process documentation, and user-facing communications.
* Experience supporting adoption, transition, knowledge transfer, reuse, standardization, or expansion of technology-enabled capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Data, Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, digital products, cloud or infrastructure initiatives, and responsible technology delivery practices.
* Demonstrated ability to influence follow-through without direct authority while respecting product, portfolio, and engineering accountabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing business priorities.

*Physical Demands and Work Environment:*

* This position is one that would normally require the person to work in a temperature-controlled office environment with other professional and management employees and continent workers, with frequent exposure to electronic office equipment.
* This position will require the employee to maintain hours during a typical day to overlap with team members and business users around the world with special attention to people in the time zones of India, Paris, and the Eastern U.S.
* This position will likely require the employee to travel a few times annually to physically meet with managers or team members.

*About You*

* You bring structure and momentum to complex initiatives without adding unnecessary process.
* You are confident facilitating Scrum ceremonies and product discussions with Engineering Managers, technical leads, senior developers, business stakeholders, and users.
* You can convert product direction and workshop discussions into clear backlog items, decisions, requirements, actions, and communication materials.
* You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple timelines, dependencies, risks, decisions, and stakeholder commitments.
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally and can prepare concise, leadership-ready presentations and pre-read materials.
* You listen carefully to users, separate observations from requirements, document feedback objectively, and support evidence-based prioritization.
* You can challenge missing information, unclear ownership, delayed actions, or unmanaged dependencies constructively and respectfully.
* You understand the difference between tracking engineering progress and managing technical quality or individual developer performance.
* You are motivated by scalable outcomes and help teams reuse, document, communicate, adopt, and expand capabilities already built.
* You are a collaborative self-starter who works within agreed portfolio strategy and product vision while taking ownership of execution discipline and follow-through.

You will build the product roadmap needed to achieve bookings, client NPS, and gross margin targets for your component.

This is a technical product role. You will work with engineering on data models, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows, and you will be a domain authority on how private funds are structured, reported, and valued. You will collaborate with internal stakeholders, clients, and prospects to identify new capabilities, partner with development teams to build and launch them, and pilot new features with clients before promoting them to the wider client base.

**Responsibilities**

* **Team Leadership:** Lead and guide a team of 8-15 developers, supporting knowledge-sharing and training to build team effectiveness.

* **Backlog Management:** Prioritize and manage the backlog, balancing client-facing features, data quality, and platform investments in line with business goals.
* **Technical Requirement Definition:** Write clear, detailed requirements and acceptance criteria, including data model changes, schema definitions, API contracts, validation rules, and data lineage expectations.
* **Private Funds Data Modeling:** Define and evolve the domain data model, including GP/LP structures, master/feeder relationships, fund and asset taxonomies and sub-types, and the treatment of capital account and PCAP statements, capital call and distribution notices, and NAV and performance data.

* **Engineering Collaboration:** Work daily with engineering on architecture trade-offs, feature design, and delivery, ensuring solutions meet client needs and scale with data volume and complexity.
* **Roadmap Creation:** Develop and communicate the product roadmap, setting strategic direction for analytics, research and deal management, managed data services, and accounting capabilities.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Keep stakeholders informed on product updates, roadmap progress, and releases.
* **Client Engagement:** Engage with Clients of Clearwater who maybe a GP, LP to understand their workflows and data needs, and translate them into actionable enhancements.
* **Operational Partnership:** Work with data operations and service teams to measure and reduce manual intervention, turning root causes into product and automation improvements.
* **Success Measurement:** Define KPIs (e.g., data accuracy, coverage, timeliness, straight-through processing rates, adoption, NPS) and use data-driven insights to guide future decisions.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

* Strong understanding of private fund structures and documents, including LPAs, capital account statements, PCAPs, capital calls and distributions, and NAV and performance reporting.
* Working technical fluency: relational data modeling, SQL, REST APIs, data pipelines, and ETL concepts. You can read schemas and engage credibly in design discussions.
* Familiarity with Generative AI and agentic AI technologies, including document intelligence, extraction, and evaluation, and an understanding of their practical limits in financial data workflows.

**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

Zuddl is the unified event platform that B2B marketing teams at companies like CrowdStrike, Figma, Stripe, TikTok, Checkpoint, and Iterable use to run their most important conferences, field events, and webinars, all from one system. We're backed by Y Combinator, Alpha Wave, and Qualcomm Ventures, and we're going after every legacy player in a market that's being rebuilt from scratch.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who has owned a product end to end before, ideally as a founder, and who works largely on their own.

You'll own a major domain of the Zuddl platform that spans several modules. Examples are the full event workflow from registration through production and check-in, or the data and integration layer that connects events to a customer's CRM and marketing stack. You own the roadmap, the technical direction with engineering, and the outcomes for that domain. Leadership will challenge your thinking and add context when you ask for it, but won't set direction for you. You are expected to frame ambiguous problems, make hard tradeoffs, and drive complex cross-functional work without much intervention.

You should also be truly AI-native. At Zuddl, product work runs on AI: research, specs, data analysis, and prototypes that go from problem to something clickable in days. This is how you already work, and you think about where AI creates leverage in the product itself.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

### **Working with people**

* Be the primary driver for complex, high-impact initiatives that cut across modules
* Lead cross-functional work across engineering, design, PMM, CS, Support, and Sales. Resolve disagreements and keep everyone aligned through ambiguity
* Make difficult decisions under ambiguity, with strong independent product judgment

### **Building the roadmap**

* Form your own view of where Zuddl wins, loses, and should differentiate. Spot market changes that should change direction
* Look past individual requests to find the systemic problems underneath, and decide which gaps deserve real investment
* Understand not just what competitors built, but why, and where they're heading. Decide where we match, differentiate, or ignore
* Prioritize major investments on your own and make the hard tradeoffs
* Own your OKRs and the roadmap behind them, including how modules fit together as one platform

### **Building the feature**

* Bring strong customer intuition from repeated exposure to users and workflows. Form a sharp initial view, then use research to validate or challenge it
* Frame complex, ambiguous problems well. Challenge the premise and reframe before the team commits to a solution
* Write PRDs with clear justification for every call
* Have strong judgment on where to match the market, where to differentiate, and where not to invest
* Find the abstractions and platform investments that unlock multiple future features, without over-generalizing
* Break complex initiatives into stages that reduce product, customer, and technical risk
* Say no to low-leverage work, even under customer or internal pressure
* Hold a very high bar for end-to-end workflows. Catch the subtle friction and inconsistency others miss
* See second- and third-order consequences before they become customer or engineering problems

### **Shipping the feature**

* Own the release plan for complex or high-risk launches: feature flags, rollout cohorts, backwards compatibility, and first-time user experience
* Anticipate what Sales, CS, Support, and Implementation will need, and drive enablement
* Shape positioning for complex or strategic launches, grounded in customer, market, and competitive understanding
* Work out why a launch is or isn't working, and decide the right response: product, UX, GTM, or enablement
* Assess partnership and integration opportunities with external third parties

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning a product end to end, from roadmap to execution
* Founder or founder-like experience strongly preferred: you've built and owned a product with that level of ownership and speed
* B2B SaaS experience is a must
* Startup experience is required. You're comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and fast iteration
* Experience at a marketing- or design-led company is a strong plus. So is event tech or martech
* Truly AI-native: AI is your default for research, specs, data analysis, and prototyping, and you can show us how
* You love technology and can hold detailed conversations with your engineering team. An engineering background is a bonus
* You go deep on data and turn it into decisions
* Excellent communicator and stakeholder manager. You tell the story well, listen to other views, and still drive the decision that's best for the customer and the business
* Equally comfortable on the long-term vision, next week's release, and what went wrong with last month's launch

**How You Operate**
-------------------

* High agency: you turn business goals into execution plans without detailed direction
* First-principles thinker, willing to challenge "how we've always done it"
* Bias to action: you ship and iterate instead of waiting for perfect information
* You surface risks early
* Accountable: you own the wins and the misses

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Your domain has a clear roadmap the company trusts and a track record of shipping against it
* Launches land well with customers, and Sales, CS, and Support are ready for them
* Your decisions hold up, and the team needs little leadership intervention to move

description:
Product · Bengaluru

You make *The Ken’s* corporate subscription a product that companies want, that their employees use, and that gets better every quarter.

Bengaluru; full-time; 2 to 4 years of experience.

  

Link Copied

  

### **About the role**

Companies already buy *The Ken* for their people. Corporate subscriptions are a significant percentage of our subscription revenue and one of the fastest-growing parts of it.

We want a corporate product that companies large and small find compelling enough to buy on their own, through the self-serve path we’ve had since 2018, without needing to be sold to. Something a 24-year-old analyst, a 34-year-old manager, and a 48-year-old business head can each use, even if what they take from it differs. Something that bundles in what we already do well beyond the daily story, such as workshops, talks, and live events, so they become part of an annual relationship rather than one-off revenue. Something that is visibly used, so that renewal is the default.

This role owns that product.

### **What you will do**

**Own the corporate product.** Define what a corporate subscription includes, for whom, at what tiers, and why. Write it down, ship it, keep changing it as you learn.

**Design for three kinds of employee.** Work out what early-career, mid-level, and senior people each need from *The Ken* and build the experiences that serve them: onboarding paths, briefings, formats, cohorts. One login for everyone is the starting point, not the product.

**Package what we already make.** Turn workshops, talks, live events, podcasts, and newsletters into things a corporate customer gets as part of the subscription. Decide what’s included, what’s an add-on, and what we stop.

**Own onboarding, activation, and engagement.** The product is only as good as the share of seats that get used. Build the onboarding flow, the activation nudges, and the account-level engagement view, and make seat usage a number everyone can see.

**Make the self-serve path work for companies.** A company should be able to discover, evaluate, buy, and expand without a call, and the buyer’s experience (admin, billing, seat management, reporting) should be as good as the reader’s.

**Define the measurement, then decide by it.** We don’t have account-level or seat-level measurement today. Define what it should count (seats active, engagement by segment, renewal, and expansion) and get it built. Know which packages activate, which features drive renewal, and where companies drop off. Kill what isn’t working.

**Talk to customers constantly.** HR and L&D buyers, the business heads who sponsor a subscription, the employees who use it or don’t. Bring what you hear into the product every month.

**Feed the people who sell.** Give them a product that’s easy to explain, obviously different, and backed by usage data that makes the renewal conversation short.

**Hold the line with the newsroom.** Many corporate customers are companies we’ve reported on critically, and they still buy. That’s the point. Exclusive features for corporates mean access, format, convenience, and curation. We never soften coverage. You keep that clear.

### **What we are looking for**

2 to 4 years in product management, growth, or a product-adjacent role at a subscription or B2B software business, ideally one where companies could buy without a salesperson. We care more about what you’ve owned and what happened to its numbers than where you worked.

You will do well here if:

– You’ve owned something end to end and can show what its numbers did while you had it.
  
– You’ve talked to enough customers to have been surprised by them.
  
– You like working out what different people need from the same product, and you’re happy building for a 24-year-old and a 48-year-old at once.
  
– You can build and read a funnel, a cohort view, and a renewal forecast, and present them to the founders monthly.
  
– You’ve killed something you built because the data said so.
  
– You can work across software, content, events, and people in the same week: an onboarding email, a workshop, a per-seat pricing argument.
  
– You read *The Ken* or something like it, and you’d rather sell a hard product honestly than an easy one loosely.
  
– Bonus: experience with L&D buyers, with packaging events or workshops into a subscription, or with seat-based pricing and activation metrics.

### **What you get**

A product of your own, with revenue attached, in a company small enough that your decisions ship. A customer base that already buys and renews, and that nobody has yet built a real product for. Resources in place: self-serve rails, a product and design team, events and workshops to bundle. And, over a year, the experience most product people at 2 to 4 years never get: owning a line from packaging to renewal, with the numbers to prove it.

Have questions?
  
Mail us at careers@the-ken.com with the name of the position in the subject line.

title: Engineering Product Manager
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Cisco Cloud Control is Cisco's AI-native platform and the front door to all of Cisco. It is the unified operations platform for agentic IT, and it is designed to be the platform of record for cross-domain operations: one login, one experience across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. This Platform is a substrate that AI Canvas, the AI Assistant, and Cloud Control Studio are built on, and it's the governed harness that lets operators and AI agents act on real infrastructure safely.
  
A platform of record is only as good as the products standing on it. Convergence comes through reusable platform services: identity, tenancy, authorization, assets, topology, telemetry, search, navigation, audit, and agent actions. Every Cisco product has to come onto those services without losing the depth its customers depend on. That is the work this role owns.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
You be responsible for the end-to-end relationship with the portfolio of products integrating into Cisco Cloud Control. This role is prioritized to integration. We do not own the domain products themselves or the platform services they consume. We own how the two meet: the strategy, the contracts, the sequencing, and the experience a product team has when it comes onto the platform.
  
  

* Lead the integrating product portfolio. Be the single point of contact and the accountable product owner for every product already coming onto Cisco Cloud Control. Hold the plan, the sequencing, the dependencies, and the dates. Escalate early, and bring a decision rather than a status.
* Be responsible for the integration strategy. Define what it means to be on the platform: the tiers of integration, what a product gets at each tier, what it owes in return, and the order in which the portfolio moves through them. Make the calls on identity, entitlement, navigation, telemetry, agent-ready context, and user experience consistency, and hold the line when a single product wants an exception that would fragment the platform.
* Build for self-service. Turn every capability the platform offers into something a product team can embrace on its own: documented contracts, reference implementations, sandboxes, validation tooling, and a platform engagement checklist that gets a team from first contact to production without a meeting series. Treat every support request as a defect in the self-service path.
* Drive the roadmap with engineering. Write the requirements, define the acceptance criteria, and prioritize the platform backlog against what the integrating portfolio actually needs. Partner with platform engineering, design, and the Cisco Unified Identity team on sequencing and trade-offs.
* Align stakeholders at Cisco scale. Work across product management, engineering, design, security, legal, privacy, support, and go-to-market in multiple business units and time zones. Get senior leaders to a shared decision, write it down, and keep it decided.
* Represent the integrating product teams. You are their advocate inside the platform and the platform's advocate inside their planning. Bring their friction back as roadmap, not as anecdote.
* Make it measurable. Define and report the metrics that say whether the platform is scaling: time to integrate, share of products self-serving, integration defects, and the adoption those integrations produce downstream.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* 8 or more years in product management, including 4 or more years owning a platform, developer platform, or internal service that other product teams build on.
* Demonstrated ownership of large scale, multi-team programs from strategy through delivery, at the scale of an enterprise portfolio rather than a single product.
* Experience defining and shipping platform capabilities as self-service: documented contracts or application programming interfaces, onboarding guides, and tooling that reduce the need for hands-on support.
* Proven ability to align multiple senior stakeholders with competing priorities and drive them to a durable decision.
* Experience with software as a service products, including multi-tenancy, identity and access management, entitlement, and cloud operations.
* Excellent written communication. You can write a one-page decision document that a vice president and a staff engineer both act on.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning capabilities in a shipping product, and a working grasp of what agentic AI requires from an underlying platform.
* Experience with an enterprise platform consolidation or migration: bringing independent products onto shared identity, navigation, and data foundations.
* Background in networking, security, or observability products.
* Familiarity with micro-frontend architectures, application programming interface gateways, and shared user experience component systems.
* Experience building a partner or developer program, including certification, tiering, and self-service onboarding.
* Track record operating across geographic regions and data residency requirements.

------------

Join the Intuit Platform and Development Xcceleration group as a Senior Staff Product Manager. The PDX group builds the foundational capabilities that developers across Intuit rely on to build and run flagship applications on cloud native infrastructure at scale. Intuit believes in open source, both as a consumer and a contributor, and our engineers participate actively in communities including CNCF, Istio, and Argo.

We're looking for a product leader who can own two connected platform domains: the systems that provision and run Intuit's cloud infrastructure, and the systems that make Intuit's APIs and services usable by AI agents, not just human developers. You'll set direction for how infrastructure gets provisioned against policy, and for how AI agents discover, integrate with, and operate Intuit's internal services with less and less human intervention over time.

This role carries senior staff scope. You'll set product strategy independently, make tradeoffs other teams will build against, and represent these platforms directly to engineering and executive stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Intuit's infrastructure orchestration and provisioning platform, working closely with the engineering teams who build and operate it.
* Own the product strategy and roadmap for Intuit's agent-readiness platform, which evaluates how usable Intuit's internal APIs and services are for AI agents and drives the work that closes the gaps.
* Define the metrics that matter for each platform, from infrastructure reliability and provisioning speed to how much manual work it still takes before an agent can operate a given capability end to end, and use those metrics to prioritize the roadmap.
* Partner with the teams that define platform policy, identity, access, lifecycle rules, so that what you build upholds that policy rather than duplicating or drifting from it.
* Work with capability teams across Intuit to help them raise their agent-readiness scores, generate the integration assets they're missing, and turn what used to be manual, tribal-knowledge work into something an agent or a new engineer can follow directly.
* Represent both platforms to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, with a clear narrative tying platform investment to developer productivity and to Intuit's broader AI strategy.
* Build and run a scrum team based in India, setting the cadence, backlog discipline, and quality bar that let a distributed team ship independently.

* 10 or more years of product management experience, including platform, infrastructure, or developer-tools products.

* Strong experience with AI Evals, model evaluations, technical use cases, shared platform capabilities, driving adoption and growth of platform capabilities, and leveraging AI to assess technical capabilities, and agentic PDLC.

Software has entered an era where humans and AI build side by side. As this shift accelerates, the definition of strong technical talent is changing. We give companies better ways to identify and invest in next-generation skills.  
  
People at HackerRank care deeply about the impact of their work and sweat the small details so our customers can be wildly successful with products they genuinely love to use. We move with urgency and believe great outcomes come from high standards.

#### **About the role**

HackerRank Interviews is a live technical interviewing platform designed to evaluate how candidates solve realistic engineering problems, not just whether they can pass an algorithm test. Candidates and interviewers collaborate in a shared workspace using coding tools, production-style repositories, and Plan-Build-Review tasks. The platform also supports observable AI-assisted development, letting teams assess how candidates prompt, review, and apply AI-generated work, with observation tools and post-interview reports giving hiring teams clearer, structured evidence for decisions.  
In this role, you'll help lead the Interviews product - an AI-native, pair-programming interview experience that gives interviewers the ability to collaborate with candidates on real-world problems and code repos. title: Product Manager III, Amazon Business India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About Amazon Business:  
Join Amazon Business, where we're revolutionizing B2B commerce. As a rapidly growing $50 billion global business, we're building a future where businesses of all sizes can find, discover, and purchase everything they need with unprecedented ease and intelligence. Our mission: to become the world's most customer-centric company and the preferred strategic partner for smart business buying. From solo entrepreneurs to Fortune 500 companies, we serve diverse business customers across eleven countries, reimagining procurement with innovative solutions that drive efficiency and growth.  
At Amazon Business, it's still Day 1. If you're passionate about solving complex challenges, creating disruptive solutions, and making history, this is your opportunity. Bring your insight, imagination, and healthy disregard for the impossible as we unlock the vast potential of B2B commerce in India.
  
  
The Role:  
Are you excited about building products that transform how millions of businesses discover and adopt e-commerce?  
Amazon Business India is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India.  
  
The Vision: We believe the next frontier in B2B commerce is moving from generic experiences to deeply personalized ones. Unlike B2C, Amazon Business customers register with verified business identifiers (GST, PAN), giving us rich context — industry, company size, purchase patterns — from Day 1. We intend to leverage this unique B2B advantage to deliver smarter, more relevant experiences across every customer touchpoint, both onsite and offsite.  
  
We are seeking a talented Senior Product Manager to own the Shopping Experience and Marketing Tech charter for Amazon Business in India. This is a dual-mandate role spanning two interconnected domains:  
  
1. Onsite Shopping Experience: You will re-imagine every aspect of the business customer's onsite journey — browse, search, selection and offer discovery and checkout. The objective is to simplify the end-to-end shopping experience with personalization and friction reduction to increase frequency and basket size of business customer purchases. You will create a north-star experience that enables customers to quickly discover the most relevant product or high-value action, and complete their purchase with the fewest steps possible.  
  
2. Off-App Marketing Tech: You will own the marketing technology stack that powers automated, personalized outbound engagement across every customer touchpoint off-app, including:
  

* Organic & AI surfaces — traditional search (SEO) and emerging AI platforms
* Conversational surfaces — WhatsApp and chat-based engagement
* Outbound channels — email and push notifications
* Amazon.com and social — on-platform and social media surfaces

  
You will build and scale the systems and tooling that enable marketers to create, test, and optimize customer lifecycle journeys without engineering dependency — driving high-intent engagement back into the Amazon Business app and strengthening the brand across off-app surfaces.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  

* Vision & Strategy: Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for both onsite shopping experience and off-app marketing tech — creating a unified engagement layer across all customer touchpoints
* Personalization: Drive the development of personalization capabilities that leverage business context and behavioral signals to deliver relevant experiences across onsite and offsite channels
* Customer Understanding: Develop deep understanding of business customer lifecycle patterns, procurement behaviors, and channel preferences to inform when, where, and how we engage customers
* Experience Design: Design and implement customer experiences that are contextual, frictionless, and consistent across the onsite journey and outbound channels
* Marketing Automation: Build and scale marketing automation systems that enable personalized, multi-channel customer journeys — from acquisition through retention — with self-serve tooling for marketing team
* Innovation: Pioneer new approaches to B2B customer engagement across emerging surfaces including AI platforms, conversational interfaces, and agentic experiences — positioning Amazon Business ahead of shifting customer behavior
* Metrics & Experimentation: Define success metrics, build a robust experimentation roadmap, and drive continuous optimization across all channels and lifecycle stages
* Collaboration: The roadmap will be a mix of India-first products and India adaptations of global product features. You will partner closely with senior stakeholders across engineering, science, marketing, UX design, and business intelligence teams across Amazon India and Amazon Worldwide

  
A day in the life  
You start your morning reviewing key product metrics and customer feedback, identifying signals that inform your next set of priorities. By mid-morning you are in a design review, debating trade-offs on a new feature with your engineering and design partners. After lunch you draft a product requirements document, pressure-testing assumptions with data from recent experiments. Later, you connect with cross-functional partners to align on an upcoming launch plan and resolve open dependencies.

------------------------

* 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
